verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own docs say each release ships the latest applications, libraries, and toolchains, that it is a primary platform for all major IDEs and AI/ML software, and that the full Ubuntu archive is available for packages. WSL is also positioned for web app and AI/ML development. These are broad marketing claims about installing tooling, not evidence of quick, preconfigured environments for specific frameworks or languages. Missing for 10: any documented preconfigured or templated dev-environment setup for specific frameworks/languages, how-to docs for quick setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
